# Singularized names (pluralize irregulars and the cookies special case) and
# non-ASCII names combined by deduplication.
builder
prim i integer
cls a x:i sing=data
cls b x:i sing=People
cls c x:i sing=Cookies
cls d x:i sing=analyses
cls e x:i sing=movies
cls f x:i sing=Indices
cls g y:i n=größeWert
cls h y:i n=größeListe
cls k z:i n=ÉtatCivil
cls l z:i in=étatCivilCode
cls top a:a,b:b,c:c,d:d,e:e,f:f,g:g,h:h,k:k,l:l n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
print
gc
print
